baseline.versionPolicy: Outcome requirements are stable; verify lifecycle, dependency, validation, and OpenAPI mechanisms against the pinned FastAPI, Starlette, Pydantic, and server versions.

hardOutcomes: Business facts and cross-request state have explicit owners.
Feature dependencies are acyclic and framework details remain at declared boundaries.
Request-scoped and process-scoped resources are never silently interchanged.

invariants.outcome: Feature dependencies are acyclic, and authoritative facts, cross-request state, and background work have explicit owners.
invariants.equivalenceCriteria: Any module shape qualifies when dependency evidence and mutation paths prove the same ownership and absence of cycles.

invariants.outcome: Inputs, responses, errors, authentication, resource authorization, tenant isolation, proxy trust, and secret handling enforce the actual HTTP trust boundary.
invariants.equivalenceCriteria: Alternative schema and security controls comply when negative tests prove rejection, field minimization, tenant isolation, and non-disclosure at the same boundary.

invariants.outcome: Actual lifespan hooks, dependencies, clients, sessions, tasks, streams, and shutdown paths have bounded ownership, cancellation, cleanup, and capacity behavior without hidden event-loop blocking.
invariants.equivalenceCriteria: Framework hooks or explicit owners qualify when startup, cancellation, partial failure, and shutdown tests prove resources close in dependency order and work remains bounded.

invariants.outcome: Every adopted transaction, migration, remote call, cache entry, and queued job preserves required consistency under timeout, retry, duplicate delivery, and partial failure.
invariants.equivalenceCriteria: Any transaction and delivery design qualifies when failure injection proves atomic ownership, safe retries or deduplication, and a recoverable migration path.

invariants.outcome: The real ASGI entry, configuration source, pinned dependencies, build path, health behavior, and production process model are determinable and repeatably validated from a clean checkout.
invariants.equivalenceCriteria: Any server and packaging route comply when repository commands exercise the same delivered entry and configuration without undeclared machine state.

proves: Selected application sources compile as Python syntax.
doesNotProve: The production ASGI entry starts or its external dependencies are healthy.

proves: The project-defined probe can generate and compare the public OpenAPI contract.
doesNotProve: Every deployed response matches the contract or is authorized.

proves: The repository-selected tests pass for exercised request and failure paths.
doesNotProve: Unexercised production topology, dependency outages, or concurrency limits are safe.

scenarios.failure: A response leaks fields or changes status and error shape while the generated OpenAPI document remains stale.
scenarios.requiredOutcome: Exercise representative success and error responses, compare the generated contract, and verify field filtering and resource authorization independently.

scenarios.failure: A remote write, cache mutation, commit, or message publication succeeds but its acknowledgement fails, causing a retry to repeat a non-idempotent effect or expose stale state.
scenarios.requiredOutcome: Inject failures across remote, cache, commit, and publish boundaries and prove bounded retry, idempotency, deduplication, outbox, invalidation, or an equivalent recovery protocol.

scenarios.failure: Shutdown closes a client or session while an owned request, stream, or task still uses it, or waits forever for orphan work.
scenarios.requiredOutcome: Drive cancellation and termination under load; bound admission, drain owned work, and close dependencies in a verified order.
